sentences.text: It is prayed on behalf of the Deputy, SGI, for an adjournment in the matter to facilitate him to bring on record a detail affidavit on behalf of the respondents represented by him in the matter, in terms of the undertaking given before this Court, earlier during the consideration of the present proceedings.
Prayer is not objected to by the learned counsel for the respondents.

Accordingly, Registry to list this matter again after 3(three) weeks on a date to be fixed by it.
Interim order, if any, to continue till the next date of listing.
JUDGE
